scenarios.name: Create and change a metal appearance

background_steps.name: the MCAD Software has a part document open

scenario_steps.name: an applied appearance is open in the Appearance Editor
I choose Metal from the editor creation menu
the editor switches to a new appearance named "Default Metal"
the Metal section shows Type Aluminum and Finish Polished
Relief Pattern, Cutouts and Tint are separate unchecked sections
I open the Metal Type list
it offers Aluminum, Anodized Aluminum, Chrome, Copper, Brass, Bronze, Stainless Steel and Zinc
it offers Polished, Semi-polished, Satin and Brushed
